statement: An organization applying for recognition of exemption under section 501(c)(3) that submits Form 1023 within 27 months after the end of the month in which it was legally formed has its exempt status effective from its legal date of formation; Form 1023 must be submitted electronically through Pay.gov with the required user fee.
caveat: An application submitted after the 27-month window is generally effective from the submission date, with the relief routes described in the instructions and Schedule E. Form 1023-EZ carries its own eligibility worksheet and fee. Check the current instructions and user-fee amount before filing.
